name: VFN Fiberglass Inc
old_description: This Is the Place For High Quality Fiberglass Components For Street Car's And Race Car's
about:
VFN Fiberglass Inc. operates from Addison, Illinois, where it has been a leader in the fiberglass automotive components industry for over 50 years. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but its longevity points to a stable, privately held operation.

The company manufactures a wide range of fiberglass body parts for both street and drag-racing applications. Its product line includes complete door-slammer bodies, front-end assemblies, hoods, doors, trunks, bumpers, scoops, and cowl-induction hoods. Many hoods are offered as bolt-on units designed to work with factory hinges and latches, and all street hoods are bonded with aerospace-grade adhesives. Production volumes run into the hundreds of front ends and thousands of individual panels annually.

VFN serves the automotive aftermarket, focusing on drag racers and street-performance enthusiasts. Its components are built to withstand the stresses of competition while retaining factory-style detail. Customers range from individual racers to shops building turn-key vehicles, though specific client names are not disclosed.

The business was founded on a mission to produce lightweight, durable parts that handle the abuse of drag racing without sacrificing OEM-level fit and finish. Management emphasizes that its reputation has grown through word of mouth rather than advertising, and it points to the use of aerospace adhesives as a key differentiator for product longevity.
